newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stock market hits new high on Wall St gains.
newsitem.headline: French stock market hits new high on Wall St gains.

text.p: The Paris CAC share index hit a fresh high at 2,836.14 on Wednesday, boosted by Wall Street's rise of two percent overnight, traders said. The previous high was 2,825.18.
Volume was a heavy 1.12 billion francs in the first half hour.

The whole market was up, but sentiment was particularly helped by Compagnie Bancaire's buy-out offer for minority shareholders of finance houses Cardif and Locabail, the head of equities sales at a big French brokerage said.
"It's very good news," the broker said. The offer marks Cie Bancaire's move from a holding company to an operational company.
Cie Bancaire was up 7.56 percent at 740 francs, while Paribas rose 6.15 percent to 410.9.
Paribas controls Cie Bancaire and may subscribe to half the two billion franc capital increase Bancaire is making to finance its bids.
Trading in Cardif and Locabail was suspended.
Other banks stocks posted strong gains. Societe Generale rose 2.98 percent to 657, Banque Nationale de Paris climbed 3.06 percent to 242.5.

Generale des Eaux was 3.16 percent higher at 752. France Telecom chairman Michel Bon yesterday reiterated the company's interest in buying Compagnie Generale de Videocommunications, the cable business of Generale des Eaux, which is up for sale.
